questions.old_question: Which native fixture can fault the real migrator and observe advisory-lock custody across two Marshall hosts?
questions.answer: Updater uses a fixed awaited migrator unit; Marshall serving startup does not migrate. Existing one-host updater and multi-host fleet fixtures do not combine two live migrators, pg_locks and schema_migrations under faults.
questions.proposed_catalog_edit: Tag partial; require two-host native migrator lock/ledger/closure probe before claiming concurrency evidence.
